added_capabilities: Finite stress-risk score and balance preference with pressure and idle recovery
Integer resource projection, paid resource transit, finite buffers and explicit dropped work
One-interval stage forwarding and two-interval startup capacity ramp
Common source-indexed delayed/noisy observations with same-source effective-resource normalization
Drop-adjusted demand deficit, empirical static-relative CVaR90 and physical drainage as distinct metrics
Frozen fresh704-case/seven-policy/six-regime evaluation plus independent scalar, sensor, controller and statistical audits
data_kind: Synthetic only; no live telemetry and no real resource-control adapter for V4.
realism_parameter_origin: Declared synthetic stress assumptions, not measured production values or platform defaults.
legacy_shadow_scope: shadow_replay.py is the preserved V3 observation-only recommendation adapter, not V4 validation or live control.
report_dependencies: Core experiment uses pinned NumPy; optional report builder uses pinned PyMuPDF and Matplotlib with bundled licensed Noto fonts.
reproduction_scope: One complete repetition of the same frozen validation, resumed through the original runtime after a technical interruption. This is reproducibility evidence, not additional independent cases.
